constellations.summary: High-octane Pyro normal attacker converting Bond of Life into massive single-target and AoE scythe slashes.
Masque of the Red Death damage increased by 100% and grants interruption immunity during normal attacks.
Blood-Debt Directives immediately become Due, dealing 900% AoE Pyro DMG upon retrieval and increasing All RES by 20%.
Increases Normal Attack talent level by 3 (primary damage multiplier).
Absorbing Blood-Debt decreases Burst cooldown by 2s and refunds 15 Energy.
Burst damage gains scaling equal to +700% ATK multiplied by current Bond of Life, plus +10% CRIT Rate and +70% CRIT DMG for 20s.
